metadata.description: Clark's custom Cowork skills - token tracking, terse mode, context compression, idea capture and evaluation, plus the notion-personal MCP plugin for multi-workspace Notion access, plus a guide to creating agents in Buzz

plugins.name: cowork-skills
plugins.description: Token tracking (codeburn), terse output mode (caveman), and context compression (caveman-compress)

plugins.name: idea-capture
plugins.description: Score URLs against a weighted rubric and append them to the Ideas Inbox in Notion. Handles Instagram, GitHub, YouTube, Google Drive, X, Reddit, and generic web URLs with mandatory verification of factual claims.

plugins.name: notion-personal
plugins.description: Second Notion MCP server that runs in parallel to the built-in Cowork Notion connector. Use it when you have two Notion workspaces (work + personal) and need Claude to reach both. Bundles @notionhq/notion-mcp-server. Set NOTION_TOKEN via launchctl setenv on macOS per the plugin README before installing.

plugins.name: buzz-agents
plugins.description: Create, configure, or fix an agent in Buzz (block/buzz). Covers harness selection and what each harness can and cannot do, writing agent instructions, file and MCP access, the access-control gate, and the defaults that are not shown in the creation dialog.
